author: VenomousViper
body:
Retribution
Created by Venomous_Viper1
Contributed - Upsoar
Features:
 - 3 monuments for each team (Left,Middle, Right)
 - Maximum of 15 players per team
 - Teams are Green and Blue
 - Map contains iron and diamond
Equipment (In order):
    ~ Stone Sword
    ~ Bow (Infinity)
    ~ Golden Apple (3)
    ~ Diamond Pickaxe
    ~ Glass (64)
    ~ Oak Log (64)
    ~ Cooked Fish (64)
    ~ Full Leather Armor
Map Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?4uy22evf9p74ex1
YML: http://pastebin.com/As2iWBTN
Images:  http://imgur.com/a/2TQeA

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Some things I would fix up:

- Map seems kinda small. The game-play of this would be kinda iffy. Considering the area would be bunched up, and would not provide enough room for PVP. Possibly turning the map into those of where people can kill farm non-stop. 

- The map doesn't seem to be so "original". Meaning tons of other maps on Avicus are built in the same style. Such as Quintus, as it already has problems due to it's size (referring to part 1).
